0.name: TEXT_FESHLW2020TRANSFORM_00691_RANSFORMHLW2020_000_000
0.description: Up to something? Me? Never! I am but a fun-loving imp, here to help my fellow revelers enjoy the Wake! And I can fashion you a <hex:021A020203>very<hex:021A020103> convincing guise for the masquerade. Ehehehe...
0.translation_description: Stai tramando qualcosa? Io? Ma figuriamoci! Sono solo un folletto burlone, qui per aiutare gli altri festaioli a godersi la Veglia! E posso prepararti un travestimento <hex:021A020203>davvero<hex:021A020103> convincente per la mascherata. Ehehehe...

1.name: TEXT_FESHLW2020TRANSFORM_00691_RANSFORMHLW2020_000_001
1.description: All I need is your memory of someone, someone who made a <hex:021A020203>strong<hex:021A020103> impression. Someone unforgettable, someone <hex:021A020203>powerful<hex:021A020103>. Yes, that's it...
1.translation_description: Mi basta che tu ricordi qualcuno che ti ha fatto una <hex:021A020203>forte<hex:021A020103> impressione. Una persona indimenticabile, qualcuno <hex:021A020203>potente<hex:021A020103>. Sì, proprio così...

2.name: TEXT_FESHLW2020TRANSFORM_00691_RANSFORMHLW2020_000_002
2.description: All I need is for you to recall a journey, a journey unforgettable. Traverse your memories, and tell me what you see...
2.translation_description: Mi basta che ripensi a un viaggio indimenticabile. Rivivi i tuoi ricordi e raccontami cosa vedi...

4.name: TEXT_FESHLW2020TRANSFORM_00691_A1_000_001
4.description: A journey to forge this realm anew.
4.translation_description: Un viaggio per riforgiare questo mondo.

5.name: TEXT_FESHLW2020TRANSFORM_00691_A1_000_002
5.description: A journey to end a conflict of one thousand years.
5.translation_description: Un viaggio per porre fine a un conflitto durato mille anni.

6.name: TEXT_FESHLW2020TRANSFORM_00691_A1_000_003
6.description: A journey to liberate lands near and far.
6.translation_description: Un viaggio per liberare terre vicine e lontane.

7.name: TEXT_FESHLW2020TRANSFORM_00691_A1_000_004
7.description: A journey to reclaim the night sky.
7.translation_description: Un viaggio per riconquistare il cielo notturno.

8.name: TEXT_FESHLW2020TRANSFORM_00691_RANSFORMHLW2020_000_003
8.description: Good, good. Now think of someone remarkable you encountered in that time, someone <hex:021A020203>powerful<hex:021A020103>. Yes, that's it...
8.translation_description: Bene, bene. Ora pensa a qualcuno di speciale che hai incontrato durante quel viaggio, qualcuno <hex:021A020203>potente<hex:021A020103>. Sì, proprio così...

10.name: TEXT_FESHLW2020TRANSFORM_00691_A2_000_001
10.description: A Padjali woman as gentle yet indomitable as nature itself.
10.translation_description: Una donna Padjal, gentile ma indomita quanto la natura stessa.

11.name: TEXT_FESHLW2020TRANSFORM_00691_A2_000_002
11.description: A stalwart Roegadyn woman of unshakable conviction.
11.translation_description: Una salda donna Roegadyn, dalla convinzione incrollabile.

12.name: TEXT_FESHLW2020TRANSFORM_00691_A2_000_003
12.description: A rugged Hyuran man unmatched in loyalty and valor.
12.translation_description: Un vigoroso uomo Hyur, senza pari per lealtà e valore.

13.name: TEXT_FESHLW2020TRANSFORM_00691_A2_000_004
13.description: A charming and compassionate Lalafellin lady of noble birth.
13.translation_description: Una gentildonna Lalafell affascinante e compassionevole, di nobili natali.

14.name: TEXT_FESHLW2020TRANSFORM_00691_A2_000_005
14.description: A courageous and clever Garlean man admired by many.
14.translation_description: Un garleano coraggioso e ingegnoso, ammirato da molti.

15.name: TEXT_FESHLW2020TRANSFORM_00691_A2_000_006
15.description: A wry and ambitious Garlean man who hates to be outdone.
15.translation_description: Un garleano sardonico e ambizioso, che non sopporta di essere secondo a nessuno.

16.name: TEXT_FESHLW2020TRANSFORM_00691_A2_000_007
16.description: An eccentric Miqo'te man crimson of both hair and eye.
16.translation_description: Un eccentrico Miqo'te, dai capelli e dagli occhi color cremisi.

17.name: TEXT_FESHLW2020TRANSFORM_00691_A2_100_008
17.description: A compassionate Hyuran woman who leads a “secret” organization.
17.translation_description: Una Hyur compassionevole, a capo di un'organizzazione «segreta».

18.name: TEXT_FESHLW2020TRANSFORM_00691_A2_100_009
18.description: A formidable Roegadyn man recognized for his tactical brilliance.
18.translation_description: Un formidabile Roegadyn, celebre per il suo acume tattico.

19.name: TEXT_FESHLW2020TRANSFORM_00691_A2_100_010
19.description: A stunning Miqo'te woman famed as a peerless songstress.
19.translation_description: Una splendida Miqo'te, rinomata come cantante senza pari.

20.name: TEXT_FESHLW2020TRANSFORM_00691_A2_100_011
20.description: A Hyuran gentleman with an irrepressibly inquisitive nature.
20.translation_description: Un gentiluomo Hyur dalla curiosità incontenibile.

21.name: TEXT_FESHLW2020TRANSFORM_00691_A2_100_012
21.description: A loyal Miqo'te woman who assists a gentleman inspector.
21.translation_description: Una fedele Miqo'te, assistente di un gentiluomo investigatore.

22.name: TEXT_FESHLW2020TRANSFORM_00691_A2_000_008
22.description: A proud Elezen man unmatched in the art of the lance.
22.translation_description: Un fiero Elezen, senza pari nell'arte della lancia.

23.name: TEXT_FESHLW2020TRANSFORM_00691_A2_000_009
23.description: A blue-eyed Elezen man with a heart noble and true.
23.translation_description: Un Elezen dagli occhi azzurri, dal cuore nobile e sincero.

24.name: TEXT_FESHLW2020TRANSFORM_00691_A2_000_010
24.description: A tenacious half-Elezen woman who fights for what is just.
24.translation_description: Una tenace mezz'Elezen, che lotta per ciò che è giusto.

25.name: TEXT_FESHLW2020TRANSFORM_00691_A2_000_011
25.description: A robed Lalafellin woman of the intellectual persuasion.
25.translation_description: Una Lalafell in tunica, dalle spiccate inclinazioni intellettuali.

26.name: TEXT_FESHLW2020TRANSFORM_00691_A2_000_012
26.description: A daring Hyuran man who lives free as a bird.
26.translation_description: Un audace Hyur, che vive libero come un uccello nei cieli.

27.name: TEXT_FESHLW2020TRANSFORM_00691_A2_000_013
27.description: A dauntless Hyuran man of integrity from the Far East.
27.translation_description: Un impavido e integerrimo Hyur dell'Estremo Oriente.

28.name: TEXT_FESHLW2020TRANSFORM_00691_A2_000_014
28.description: A devoted Auri woman who has mastered the art of the shinobi.
28.translation_description: Una devota donna Au Ra, maestra nell'arte degli shinobi.

29.name: TEXT_FESHLW2020TRANSFORM_00691_A2_000_015
29.description: A haughty but valorous Auri man with a yearning heart.
29.translation_description: Un guerriero Au Ra altero ma valoroso, dal cuore che anela all'amore.

30.name: TEXT_FESHLW2020TRANSFORM_00691_A2_000_016
30.description: An Auri woman strong of body and stronger of will.
30.translation_description: Una donna Au Ra forte nel corpo e ancor più nella volontà.

31.name: TEXT_FESHLW2020TRANSFORM_00691_A2_000_017
31.description: A sweet Auri woman who lives according to her faith.
31.translation_description: Una dolce donna Au Ra, che vive secondo la propria fede.

32.name: TEXT_FESHLW2020TRANSFORM_00691_A2_000_018
32.description: A crimson-garbed Hyuran woman fleet of foot and fist.
32.translation_description: Una donna Hyur vestita di rosso, agile nel passo e fulminea nei pugni.

33.name: TEXT_FESHLW2020TRANSFORM_00691_A2_000_019
33.description: A Hyuran man whose strength and compassion made him a legend.
33.translation_description: Un Hyur la cui forza e compassione ne hanno fatto una leggenda.

34.name: TEXT_FESHLW2020TRANSFORM_00691_A2_000_020
34.description: A vindictive Hyuran man of savage political cunning.
34.translation_description: Un Hyur vendicativo, dalla spietata astuzia politica.

35.name: TEXT_FESHLW2020TRANSFORM_00691_A2_000_021
35.description: A sagacious Miqo'te woman skilled in the magical arts.
35.translation_description: Una Miqo'te sagace, esperta nelle arti magiche.

36.name: TEXT_FESHLW2020TRANSFORM_00691_A2_000_022
36.description: An Elezen man who reads the stars as easily as his tomes.
36.translation_description: Un Elezen che legge le stelle con la stessa facilità con cui consulta i suoi tomi.

37.name: TEXT_FESHLW2020TRANSFORM_00691_A2_000_023
37.description: A handsome Hyuran man who fights to protect those he loves.
37.translation_description: Un affascinante Hyur, che combatte per proteggere chi ama.

38.name: TEXT_FESHLW2020TRANSFORM_00691_A2_000_024
38.description: A dainty Hyuran woman who chose to carve her own fate.
38.translation_description: Una delicata donna Hyur, che ha scelto di forgiare il proprio destino.

40.name: TEXT_FESHLW2020TRANSFORM_00691_RANSFORMHLW2020_000_004
40.description: Ehehehe... That will do nicely. Don't worry, this won't hurt much at all! Just close your eyes...
40.translation_description: Ehehehe... Benissimo. Non preoccuparti, non farà affatto male! Chiudi gli occhi...

41.name: TEXT_FESHLW2020TRANSFORM_00691_SYSTEM_000_005
41.description: The transfiguration can be removed by leaving the area, or by canceling the “Transfiguration” status effect.
41.translation_description: Puoi annullare la trasfigurazione uscendo dall'area oppure rimuovendo lo stato «Trasfigurazione».

42.name: TEXT_FESHLW2020TRANSFORM_00691_RANSFORMHLW2020_000_010
42.description: Pay no mind to this little imp! I'm <hex:021A020203>very<hex:021A020103> busy during the Wake─I've no time for mundane mummers, no.
42.translation_description: Non badare a questo piccolo folletto! Durante la Veglia ho <hex:021A020203>davvero<hex:021A020103> mille cose da fare─non ho tempo per saltimbanchi da quattro soldi.

43.name: TEXT_FESHLW2020TRANSFORM_00691_RANSFORMHLW2020_000_011
43.description: Come back with word from the Impresario...or not at all. Ehehehe...
43.translation_description: Torna con notizie dell'Impresario... o non tornare affatto. Ehehehe...
